title: Kesihatan Lanjutan
canDo: Describe symptoms in detail over a longer period
Understand hospital referral and specialist processes
Discuss test results and treatment options at a basic level
Ask about medication instructions and side effects
lifeBenefit: Navigate hospital referrals, specialists, and more detailed medical conversations.

vocab.example: Doktor bagi surat rujukan ke hospital.
vocab.exampleEn: The doctor gave a referral letter to the hospital.

vocab.example: Saya kena jumpa doktor pakar jantung.
vocab.exampleEn: I need to see a heart specialist.
When will my blood test results be ready?

vocab.example: Rawatan ni akan ambil masa berapa lama?
vocab.exampleEn: How long will this treatment take?

vocab.example: Ada kesan sampingan ubat ni tak?
vocab.exampleEn: Are there side effects to this medicine?

vocab.example: Berapa dos yang perlu saya ambil?
vocab.exampleEn: What dosage do I need to take?

vocab.example: Dia ada penyakit kronik, kena jumpa doktor kerap.
vocab.exampleEn: He/she has a chronic illness, needs to see the doctor often.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'The doctor gave me a referral letter to see a specialist.'
practiceExercises.answer: Doktor bagi saya surat rujukan untuk jumpa doktor pakar.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'When will my test results be ready, and what treatment do I need?'
practiceExercises.answer: Bila keputusan ujian saya, dan rawatan apa yang saya perlukan?

scenario.setting: A consultation with a specialist doctor after a hospital referral

script.ms: Saya dah tengok surat rujukan awak. Apa keluhan utama?
script.en: I've looked at your referral letter. What's the main complaint?

script.ms: Saya rasa sakit dada sekali-sekala sejak dua bulan.
script.en: I feel occasional chest pain for the past two months.

script.ms: Baik, kita perlu buat beberapa ujian dulu.
script.en: Alright, we need to run a few tests first.

script.ms: Bila saya boleh tahu keputusan ujian?
script.en: When can I know the test results?

script.ms: Dalam seminggu. Lepas tu kita bincang rawatan.
script.en: Within a week. After that we'll discuss treatment.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a specialist doctor conducting a consultation based on a referral letter. Ask about the main complaint and its duration, explain that tests are needed, and give a timeline for results and next steps. Speak in a calm, professional, standard-leaning register.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the specialist consultation, focusing on calm, clear medical register.
Describe a symptom and its duration to the AI specialist persona, and ask about test results and treatment.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'When will my test results be ready?'
questions.answer: Bila keputusan ujian saya akan siap?
